sections.preamble: You are a coding assistant running inside pi, a coding agent harness. Help users inspect files, run commands, and modify code.
sections.tools:
<tools>
- read: Read file contents
- grep: Search file contents for patterns (respects .gitignore)
- find: Find files by glob pattern (respects .gitignore)
- ls: List directory contents
- bash: Execute bash commands (ls, grep, find, etc.)

Additional tools may be available.
</tools>
sections.rules:
<rules>
- Use read to examine files instead of cat or sed.
- You can inspect PI_* environment variables for current model and session details.
- Be concise in your responses
- Show file paths clearly when working with files
</rules>

toolsAdded.name: read
toolsAdded.description: Read the contents of a file. Supports text files and images (jpg, png, gif, webp, bmp). Images are sent as attachments. For text files, output is truncated to 2000 lines or 50KB (whichever is hit first). Use offset/limit for large files. When you need the full file, continue with offset until complete.

path.description: Path to the file to read (relative or absolute)

offset.description: Line number to start reading from (1-indexed)

limit.description: Maximum number of lines to read

toolsAdded.name: grep
toolsAdded.description: Search file contents for a pattern. Returns matching lines with file paths and line numbers. Respects .gitignore. Output is truncated to 100 matches or 50KB (whichever is hit first). Long lines are truncated to 500 chars.

path.description: Directory or file to search (default: current directory)

glob.description: Filter files by glob pattern, e.g. '*.ts' or '**/*.spec.ts'

literal.description: Treat pattern as literal string instead of regex (default: false)

context.description: Number of lines to show before and after each match (default: 0)

limit.description: Maximum number of matches to return (default: 100)

toolsAdded.name: find
toolsAdded.description: Search for files by glob pattern. Returns matching file paths relative to the search directory. Respects .gitignore. Output is truncated to 1000 results or 50KB (whichever is hit first).

pattern.description: Glob pattern to match files, e.g. '*.ts', '**/*.json', or 'src/**/*.spec.ts'

path.description: Directory to search in (default: current directory)

toolsAdded.name: ls
toolsAdded.description: List directory contents. Returns entries sorted alphabetically, with '/' suffix for directories. Includes dotfiles. Output is truncated to 500 entries or 50KB (whichever is hit first).

limit.description: Maximum number of entries to return (default: 500)

toolsAdded.name: bash
toolsAdded.description: Execute a bash command in the current working directory. Returns stdout and stderr. Output is truncated to last 2000 lines or 50KB (whichever is hit first). If truncated, full output is saved to a temp file. Optionally provide a timeout in seconds.

timeout.description: Timeout in seconds (optional, no default timeout)

This is a read-only question: do not modify any file. End your reply with your final answer between a line `<answer>` and a line `</answer>`.

content.thinking: I've got five direct tests. The indirect ones are those that call functions in request.ts and stream.ts, so next I want to find which exported functions in those two files reach the code under test.

content.text: Five tests call it directly. It is also called through `src/anthropic-cc/request.ts` and `stream.ts`, so I'll look for tests that reach it that way.

arguments.command: cd src/anthropic-cc; grep -n "^export\|^async function\|^function" request.ts stream.ts; sed -n 240,300p request.ts; sed -n 20,40p stream.ts

I'm going through the remaining test categories: anything that calls streamAnthropicCc or the request builders, tests that reach the stream through the provider config's streamSimple, and any users of the pi099 helper. I also need to check how anthropicCcPi099ReadAbort uses the stream import and where ManagedBetaIsolation captures streamAnthropicCc.

The direct call sites are clear, and many tests go through `streamAnthropicCc` or the request builders. Next I'm checking the helper, the provider-config `streamSimple` path, and the files that only import it.

arguments.command: sed -n 25,50p tests/helpers/pi099.ts; echo ---; grep -rln "helpers/pi099" tests; echo ---; grep -rn "streamSimple(" tests src | grep -v "^src/anthropic-cc/stream.ts" | head -40; echo ---; sed -n 1,80p tests/anthropicCcPi099ReadAbort.test.ts | grep -n "stream"

content.text: Next I'll check which of the helper-importing tests actually call `captureCc`, and whether the `index*` tests use the anthropic-cc config.

Next I need the final list: the five direct callers, plus the tests that actually invoke buildAnthropicCcRequest, buildAnthropicCcRequestFromContext, or streamAnthropicCc, plus the captureCc users. content.text: Those don't reach `buildAnthropicCcHeaders`. Next I'll build the final list: direct callers, plus tests that actually call the wrappers (excluding tests that only compare function references).

arguments.command: { grep -rl "buildAnthropicCcHeaders" tests; grep -rlE "buildAnthropicCcRequest(FromContext)?\(|streamAnthropicCc\(|capture\(streamAnthropicCc|captureCc\(" tests; } | grep -v helpers/ | sort -u | tee /tmp/l.txt | wc -l; cat /tmp/l.txt

content.text:
78 test files run `buildAnthropicCcHeaders`, and none of them mock out `overrides`. I found them with grep and didn't run any tests.

- **5 call it directly:** `anthropicCcAuthModes`, `anthropicCcBetaComposition`, `anthropicCcHeaderSuppression`, `anthropicCcInlineToolsBetaFlags` and `anthropicCcOAuthBetaComposition`.
- **73 reach it indirectly** through its three production callers:
  - `buildAnthropicCcRequest` and `buildAnthropicCcRequestFromContext` in `src/anthropic-cc/request.ts`
  - `streamAnthropicCc` in `src/anthropic-cc/stream.ts`, including through the `captureCc` helper in `tests/helpers/pi099.ts`

I left out tests that only check `config.streamSimple === streamAnthropicCc` without calling it (`anthropicCcProviderConfig`, `anthropicCcApiKeyConfig`). I also left out the `indexBuiltin*`, `indexAuthAwareHeaders` and `vendor/anthropicStock` tests, because they use other paths.
